# Prepare the FASTQ dataset

## Download the FASTQ files

Download the complete paired-end FASTQ files from ENA:

```bash
mkdir -p data/fastq

wget -c https://ftp.sra.ebi.ac.uk/vol1/fastq/SRR828/008/SRR8281218/SRR8281218_1.fastq.gz -P data/fastq
wget -c https://ftp.sra.ebi.ac.uk/vol1/fastq/SRR828/008/SRR8281218/SRR8281218_2.fastq.gz -P data/fastq
wget -c https://ftp.sra.ebi.ac.uk/vol1/fastq/SRR828/006/SRR8281226/SRR8281226_1.fastq.gz -P data/fastq
wget -c https://ftp.sra.ebi.ac.uk/vol1/fastq/SRR828/006/SRR8281226/SRR8281226_2.fastq.gz -P data/fastq
wget -c https://ftp.sra.ebi.ac.uk/vol1/fastq/SRR828/005/SRR8281245/SRR8281245_1.fastq.gz -P data/fastq
wget -c https://ftp.sra.ebi.ac.uk/vol1/fastq/SRR828/005/SRR8281245/SRR8281245_2.fastq.gz -P data/fastq
wget -c https://ftp.sra.ebi.ac.uk/vol1/fastq/SRR828/003/SRR8281243/SRR8281243_1.fastq.gz -P data/fastq
wget -c https://ftp.sra.ebi.ac.uk/vol1/fastq/SRR828/003/SRR8281243/SRR8281243_2.fastq.gz -P data/fastq
```

## Check the FASTQ files

```bash
test "$(find data/fastq -maxdepth 1 -name '*.fastq.gz' | wc -l)" -eq 8
gzip -t data/fastq/*.fastq.gz
echo "All eight FASTQ files passed the gzip integrity check."
```

Data source: [NCBI BioProject PRJNA482620](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/bioproject/PRJNA482620).
